title: Bedroom Product Staging Studio
description: An interactive 3D product staging environment where users configure a virtual bedroom showroom featuring a corset displayed on a mannequin stand. Users adjust lighting color temperature, corset placement, material properties, and camera angles while maintaining a fixed energy budget across all light sources, with full undo/redo support.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 (via importmap/CDN) implementing an interactive bedroom product staging studio. Load minimalistic_modern_bedroom.glb as the room environment and Corset.glb as a featured fashion product displayed inside the room. Camera: Use OrbitControls with initial position looking into the bedroom at a 30-degree downward angle, constrained to stay inside the room boundaries. Lighting: Place 3 point lights (key, fill, accent) with a TOTAL energy budget of 6.0 intensity units. A conservation law applies: increasing one light's intensity must proportionally decrease the others so the sum always equals 6.0. Add a warm ambient light at 0.15 intensity. Interactions (10-14 steps required): 1) Draggable corset placement via raycasting — click and drag the corset to reposition it on any surface in the bedroom (floor, bed, shelf). 2) A right-side HTML panel with sliders controlling: key light intensity (0-4), fill light intensity (0-4), accent light intensity (0-4) — all coupled so total stays at 6.0. When one slider moves, redistribute deficit/surplus proportionally among the other two. 3) Color temperature picker for each light (2700K-6500K mapped to RGB). 4) Corset scale slider (0.5x to 2.0x). 5) Corset Y-rotation dial (0-360 degrees). 6) Material override toggle: switch corset between original PBR material and a glossy metallic gold variant. 7) Undo/Redo buttons tracking all state changes (placement, lighting, scale, rotation, material) using a history stack of snapshots (max 30). Each slider change on mouseup, each drag completion, each toggle counts as one history entry. Display a small HUD showing current total light energy and history stack depth. Add subtle HDRI-style environment mapping using PMREMGenerator with a generated neutral studio environment for reflections. Ensure all models cast and receive shadows with PCFSoftShadowMap. The panel should be semi-transparent dark glass style with white text.
